title: Ex-Federated systems (Pembina): Swan Hills, Northern, Brazeau, Western
dek: There is no Federated system today. Pembina bought Federated Pipe Lines in 2000 for C$340 million and retired the name, re-segmenting the network into named systems that still file tolls. The Swan Hills crude mainline to Edmonton is the documented direct descendant; the Northern, Brazeau and Western systems carry the NGL and BC legs on a lineage Pembina has never published, drawn here as inference and dashed. Learn the four current names; Federated is history.
